review_note: An étale surjective presentation U→F has equivalence relation R=U×_F U with étale projections and a sheaf coequalizer diagram. Independently reviewed the pinned original theorem statement embedded in Stage A against the reconstructed standalone formulation; no proofs/remarks opened. Preliminary verdict only.
statement:
In the chosen big fppf site over a base scheme $S$, an **algebraic space** is a sheaf with a representable diagonal and a surjective étale atlas $h_U\to F$ from a scheme $U/S$. A map of presheaves $a:F\to G$ is **representable** if all Yoneda test fibres $h_T\times_G F$ are schemes.

An **étale equivalence relation** on a scheme $U/S$ is a subfunctor represented by $R$ with an equivalence-relation map $(s,t):R\to U\times_S U$ whose projections $s,t:R\to U$ are étale. The quotient $U/R$ means the quotient **fppf sheaf** of the equivalence relation, not a presheaf-level orbit set.

Let $F$ be an algebraic space over $S$. Let $f : U \to F$ be a
surjective \'etale morphism from a scheme to $F$. Set $R = U \times_F U$.
Then
\begin{enumerate}
\item $j : R \to U \times_S U$ defines an equivalence relation on
$U$ over $S$ (see
Groupoids, Definition \ref{groupoids-definition-equivalence-relation}).
\item the morphisms $s, t : R \to U$ are \'etale, and
\item the diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
R \ar@<1ex>[r] \ar@<-1ex>[r] &
U \ar[r] &
F
}
$$
is a coequalizer diagram in $\Sh((\Sch/S)_{fppf})$.
\end{enumerate}
